Native service time is normalized to 2026-09-21 09:00 UTC plus Sequence seconds before completion. r7 sequence 93 starts at 09:10 UTC, with subsequent observations one second apart. Local GLACIER Expedited completion is five minutes after admission, not the measured AWS latency. Pending observations precede that boundary and Drain runs only at sequence 93. Exact captured restore expiry strings remain September 23/25 UTC midnight.

Reopen boundaries are local persistence regressions injected into native control sequences: pending state, completion work, shortened expiry, and real get-only sessions survive reconstructed memory/SQLite stacks.

Payload Body/Plaintext retain all captured bytes in base64 (r7 37 bytes, r8 30 bytes). Automatic checksum fields, provider transport metadata, error prose and generated LastModified instants are not equality contracts. ETag, length, class, restored plaintext, restore state, expiry, status and structural error details remain assertions.

Native list omissions normalize to SDK nil RestoreStatus/RestoreExpiryDate; absent HEAD/GET restore/storage-class headers are explicit assertions. The notification-control object remains solely because its actual presence is part of the captured list response.

The syntactically valid missing version in r7 sequence 32 binds to the generated bounds-object version while querying glacier, preserving NoSuchVersion without provider-specific IDs. All extant versions bind to their creation results.

SupplementalEvidence.upgrade preserves the separate owned bucket capture stackd-restore-upgrade-16eb5fe5e60b. Its native sequence/label references cover pending Bulk-to-Standard/Expedited admission, unchanged-Days requirements, downgrade rejection, and two measured completed HEAD responses. Exact captured September 23 midnight expiry remains unchanged; local retained reopen is injected before the Standard upgrade and completion drain.

The final isolated scenario is explicitly DerivedRegression, not AWS expiration/copy evidence: local completion due at September 21 23:59 is drained after midnight; expiry must derive from persisted due, remain September 23 midnight, survive reopen, close source GET at the exact boundary, leave a copied STANDARD object independent, and permit a fresh restore.
